authorizes: strategy parameters only; funded venue permission remains the owner's separately armed REAL_MONEY switch
claim: Recent aggressive buying raises the chance that a resting ask is picked off, and recent aggressive selling does the same to a bid. Scale each trade burst by nearby displayed same-side dollars, remember it at fast and slow horizons, and widen only the attacked side.

scoring_recipe.forward_start: the git commit containing this file
scoring_recipe.unit: one attributed maker fill and its 1s, 15s, 1m and 5m signed markouts
scoring_recipe.primary: 15-second signed markout after fees, reported with fill count and maker share
secondary: round-trip net PnL after venue fees
fill rate by flow-score band and protected side
place, amend and cancel socket-write-to-ack latency
scoring_recipe.bounded_trial: minimum venue notional; review after 30 attributed fills or 60 minutes of enabled quoting, whichever occurs first
scoring_recipe.comparator: the fee-corrected no-flow arm, plus the funded canary's earlier fills as descriptive pre-change evidence
scoring_recipe.cadence: at the trial boundary, then daily if the owner keeps the rule enabled

measured_at_registration.evidence_class: Lane-1 seen-tape selection only; it is not forward evidence

known_weaknesses: Every grid arm was shaped and graded on the same two seen dates.
Every tested arm loses after the full fee assumption; the selected rule is protection evidence, not a profitable market-making result.
The replay treats quote opportunities independently and does not model inventory, stops or another sleeve holding the symbol.
Displayed L50 and public trades give a conservative queue bound, not the venue's private matching priority.
Two dates cannot establish regime stability; forward capture exists to replace this narrow tape with causal unseen data.
